extDescription.message: Spots the videos playing on any page and saves them in one click. Never touches DRM-protected content.

captureHint.message: This player doesn't expose a file. Grabby replays the video from the start, muted and sped up, and records it. Don't skip ahead while it runs.

rawNotice.message: Very large stream: saved as-is without conversion.

st_offline.message: Connection lost · trying again in $S$ s

err_expired.message: The video's link expired during the pause. Open the video's page again, then restart the download: what was already received is reused when possible.

err_no_ranges.message: The server doesn't allow this kind of download.

menuPage.message: Download this page's video with Grabby

quickNoneBody.message: Play the video, then try again.

bulkHint.message: Best quality, two at a time

trimHint.message: Cut at the nearest keyframe: the clip may start a few seconds early.

subsApartHint.message: This format can't hold subtitles: they'll be saved next to the video, as .srt.

err_http_403.message: The site refused access to the video (403).

err_http_404.message: The video is no longer available on the server (404).

err_http_other.message: The server returned an error. Try again in a moment.

err_ffmpeg.message: The file couldn't be assembled. The format may not be supported.

err_protected.message: This video is protected. Grabby doesn't download protected content.

err_too_large.message: Too large to assemble in the browser (over 1.5 GB). Pick a lower quality.

err_capture_failed.message: Nothing was recorded. Start the video, then try again.

err_capture_unavailable.message: This player can't be recorded. Reload the page and try again.

err_unknown.message: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

protectedBody.message: This video is encrypted by its publisher (DRM). Grabby never bypasses protection.

liveBody.message: Live streams can't be downloaded yet.

restrictedBody.message: The browser doesn't let extensions read this page. Open a regular website to find videos.

emptyBody.message: Start playing the video: Grabby picks it up as soon as it loads.

firstRunBody.message: Only download videos you have the right to keep: your own, free-licensed ones, or with the author's permission.

set_saveAs_hint.message: Opens the save dialog for every download.

set_privacy.message: Grabby doesn't collect any data. Everything stays on your device.

hiddenHint.message: Grabby downloads this video in the background: keep watching as usual. You'll get a message when it's done.

set_notify_hint.message: Shows a notification when a download finishes.

shrinkHint.message: Grabby shrinks the picture itself, in the browser: much slower than a plain download (several minutes, more for a film). It keeps going in the background.

browserAsksNote.message: It's a browser setting, and it comes before Grabby's.

browserAsksBody.message: Turn off "Ask where to save each file" so Grabby saves directly.

set_template_hint.message: Tick what the name is made of, in this order.

browserAsksTitle.message: Your browser asks where to save
